湾区长者坐车省钱指南: Senior transit discounts in the Bay Area
65 岁办 Senior Clipper 卡；旧金山低收入居民 65 岁起可免费: At 65, get a Senior Clipper card; lower-income San Francisco residents 65+ can ride Muni free; paratransit for those who can’t ride regular transit
年满 65 岁可以办长者 Clipper 卡：BART 票价减 62.5%，Mu: At 65 you can get a Senior Clipper card: 62.5% off BART, $1.40 senior single rides on Muni, $1 on VTA and SamTrans, $1.37 a senior local ride with Clipper on AC Transit. San Francisco residents 65+ with family income at or below 100% of Bay Area median can apply to ride Muni free. Anyone who can't use regular transit because of a disability or health condition can apply for ADA paratransit.

在湾区坐车，65 岁是省钱的分界线：满 65 岁就能办长者 Clipper 卡，: For Bay Area transit, 65 is where the savings start: from 65 you can get a Senior Clipper card and pay senior fares on BART, Muni, VTA, SamTrans and AC Transit. Get the card first, then see whether your city has an extra free program; for anyone who can't ride regular transit, there is pre-booked door-to-door paratransit.
第一步：65 岁办 Senior Clipper 卡: Step one: get a Senior Clipper card at 65
怎么办：网上、邮寄、电邮或传真申请，也可以到 Clipper 客服中心当面办；B: How: apply online, by mail, email or fax, or in person at a Clipper Customer Service Center; BART says that at staffed locations you can apply and receive the discount card immediately. You need an accepted ID to verify your birth date.
长者卡可以转进手机钱包使用；没开网上账户的，可以打 Clipper 客服 877: You can transfer a Senior card to your phone's wallet; without an online account, Clipper Customer Service at 877.878.8883 can help.
Muni 官网写明，直接刷信用卡或借记卡付的是成人单程票；要长者价，就刷长者 C: Muni says a tapped credit or debit card pays an adult single-ride fare; for the senior fare, tap your Senior Clipper card.
BART：持 Senior Clipper 卡，票价减 62.5%。: BART: 62.5% off with a Senior Clipper card.
Muni（旧金山）：单程 $1.40（Clipper 或 MuniMobile）: Muni (San Francisco): single ride $1.40 on Clipper or MuniMobile, good for 120 minutes; $1.50 cash; monthly pass $43; cable car $4 before 7 a.m. or after 9 p.m.
VTA（南湾）：单程 $1；日票 $3 和月票 $30 只能用 Clipper，: VTA (South Bay): single ride $1; the $3 day pass and $30 monthly pass are Clipper only, not sold for cash. A single ride paid with Clipper includes 2 hours of free transfers, and Clipper stops charging for the day once you have paid the $3 day-pass price.
SamTrans（半岛）：单程 Clipper $1.00、现金 $1.10，日: SamTrans (Peninsula): single ride $1.00 on Clipper, $1.10 cash; day pass $2.00; monthly pass $27.00.
AC Transit（东湾）：长者本地单程用 Clipper $1.37、现金: AC Transit (East Bay): a senior local single ride is $1.37 on Clipper or $1.50 in cash, about half the adult fare; paying with Clipper, local rides cost at most $3 a day and $41.50 a month (fares from July 1, 2026).
旧金山：65 岁及以上低收入居民免费坐 Muni: San Francisco: free Muni for lower-income residents 65+
SFMTA 的“长者免费坐 Muni”（Free Muni for Senior: SFMTA's Free Muni for Seniors gives San Francisco residents 65+ with gross family income at or below 100% of Bay Area median free Muni rides, cable cars included, on a Clipper card. Applying online is fastest: enter your registered Senior Clipper card's serial number, or upload proof of age if you don't have one. You can also download the application in Chinese and mail or drop it off at the SFMTA Customer Service Center (11 South Van Ness Avenue, ATTN: FREE MUNI). Approval takes up to 3 weeks with an existing Clipper card and up to 4 weeks if a new card is needed.
SFMTA 写明：这个项目在继续，卡上原来显示的 2025 年 6 月 30 日: SFMTA says the program continues: the June 30, 2025 expiration date some cards showed was updated to 2028 on July 1, 2025.
未满 65 岁、有残障：Clipper Access 卡（原名 RTC）: Under 65 with a disability: Clipper Access (formerly RTC)
Clipper Access 是给未满 65 岁、有符合条件残障的乘客办的优惠卡: Clipper Access is the discount card for riders under 65 with qualifying disabilities, also 62.5% off BART. There are two paths: Basic eligibility (for example a Medicare card held by someone under 65, a DMV placard registration receipt, or existing ADA paratransit eligibility) and Medical eligibility (certified by a California licensed professional). When you apply, transit agency staff photocopy your documents and take your photo. Elders 65 and over simply get a Senior card.
出门困难：申请 ADA 辅助交通（paratransit）: Hard to get out: apply for ADA paratransit
因为残障或健康原因没法自己坐公交、地铁的人，可以申请 ADA 辅助交通：预约厢型: People who can't use buses or trains on their own because of a disability or health condition can apply for ADA paratransit: pre-booked van or taxi rides. In San Francisco it's SF Paratransit: general questions 415.351.7000 (Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–4:45 p.m.), SF Access reservations 415.285.6945, option 2 (daily 7 a.m.–6 p.m.). In the East Bay it's East Bay Paratransit, run by AC Transit and BART: (510) 287-5000, during AC Transit and BART operating hours, within ¾ mile of a bus route or BART station, with a rider guide in Chinese on its site. In other counties, ask the local transit agency's paratransit office.
收入符合条件的湾区居民可以申请 Clipper START，坐湾区公共交通单程五: Bay Area residents who meet the income limit can apply for Clipper START: 50% off single rides on Bay Area public transit. For a one-person household the gross (pre-tax) income limit is $31,920; CalFresh participants qualify automatically.
